# One Time Payments

One Time Payments is documented as separate operations:

- [Create payment transaction](https://developer.paylov.uz/payment-without-registration/create-transaction)
- [Confirm payment](https://developer.paylov.uz/payment-without-registration/confirm-payment)

## Notes (extraction)
- The page is not linked from the site navigation. The requested EN, RU and UZ trailing-slash URLs each return HTTP 403; the corresponding `.html` URLs return HTTP 200 with the index content extracted here. No images occur in the content.
- EN, RU and UZ agree on the two operations. RU links use /ru/payment-without-registration/create-transaction and /ru/payment-without-registration/confirm-payment; UZ links use /uz/payment-without-registration/create-transaction and /uz/payment-without-registration/confirm-payment. Only explanatory prose and link labels are translated.
